For the first labeling interaction, open [http://maker:4001/labels.html](http://maker:4001/labels.html) and click **Save link** once. Then tell me whether adding a label at save time feels natural.

I’ve assumed labels are optional and placed the label field directly in the save box. For this walkthrough, it is prefilled with “learning” so the single save action shows the resulting label on the bookmark card.
